#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
go mod download
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o app .

module notes

go 1.26.0

require modernc.org/sqlite v1.63.0
